data.one_liner: Keycloak Single Sign-On authentication package for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Keycloak Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication into Flutter apps using OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect. Manages tokens automatically under the hood and provides a user authentication state stream.
use_when: You need to authenticate users via Keycloak in your Flutter application.
You want automatic token management and secure token storage using Keychain or Keystore.
avoid_when: You are using Firebase or Supabase authentication instead of Keycloak.
You need automated tests for the authentication flow, which are unsupported due to the webview login requirement.
strengths: Provides an authentication state stream to keep the app in sync with login status changes.
Automatically manages and securely stores tokens under the hood.
Supports custom iOS/macOS web authentication session settings.
weaknesses: All test files were removed because users must log in via the webview, making it untestable.
Requires native configuration adjustments on Android, iOS, and macOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding a valid redirect URI in the Keycloak console, setting up custom schemes in Android build.gradle (manifestPlaceholders) and iOS/macOS Info.plist, and removing android:taskAffinity='' from AndroidManifest.xml if using Flutter v3.22.0 or newer.
